s: The low rate of prescriptions of AOMs may date to the early history of obesity treatment with pharmacotherapy. In the early to mid-1990s, FDA approved three drugs -- phentermine, fenfluramine, and dexfenfluramine -- to treat obesity. In particular, providers began to prescribe a combination known as “fen-phen,” with the “fen” referring to fenfluramine or dexfenfluramine and the “phen” referring to phentermine.
